wholePhysicalScope: Native outline and fort identity plus HABS MI-25 measured plans and elevations. Width is approximately 31.8 metres and the full survey ridge rises around 7.5 metres above the parade-ground grade.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the limestone quarters, hipped roof, three chimney stacks and harbor gallery.
limitations: The structure covers the original stone quarters and attached galleries. The surrounding fort walls, gate, and separate officers’ buildings are outside the model footprint.
Window trim, shutters and masonry follow the measured elevations and the public-domain historic photograph. Present-day paint and exact mortar pattern are approximate.
